Quoting an earlier finding for context:

> **<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub> quoted finding</sub></sub>

That was handled under the follow-up issue.
A badge in a code span is not a marker: `**P1 Badge**`.

A badge in a fence is not a marker:
```
**P1 Badge**
```
